dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ……目覚ましもセットしたし、眠るか」
dialogues.en: "Hoo... alarm clock set, now to sleep."
dialogues.text: "Hoo... alarm clock set, now to sleep."

dialogues.jp:
俺は布団に潜り込むと、目を｛つむ／瞑｝り暗闇へと沈ん
でいった……。
dialogues.en:
I crept under the covers, and let the darkness overtake
me...
dialogues.text:
I crept under the covers, and let the darkness overtake
me...

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましもセットしたし、さて寝ますかね。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm clock, I fell asleep.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm clock, I fell asleep.
